action_items: Backend suite has no tests; all business flows are local-first per spec. The probed /api/health path returns 404 because the existing FastAPI status endpoint is a skeleton and is not used by these flows.
Authentication, support, exports, payments, and email integrations remain MOCKED local/demo interactions as documented in the briefing.

checks.criterion: Public marketing experience is available at / with collectFlow branding and navigation to features, pricing, calculator, FAQ, login, and signup
checks.name: public-marketing-navigation
checks.evidence: Homepage rendered collectFlow branding; navigation reached /pricing, /calculator, /faq, and /login without blank/error state.

checks.criterion: GST and overdue calculators work interactively
checks.name: calculators-update-and-route
checks.evidence: Changing GST amount/mode and overdue days changed output values; Generate invoice routed to /login. Executed through public preview URL.

checks.criterion: Pricing and FAQ pages provide the requested interactions
checks.name: pricing-faq-interactions
checks.evidence: Annual toggle changed pricing, invoice-volume slider changed recommendation, FAQ search filtered, and Contact support displayed Message queued.

checks.criterion: Demo signup/login enters the billing workspace
checks.name: demo-login-dashboard
checks.evidence: One-click demo login reached /app with Good morning, Arjun, revenue chart, and Recent invoices.

checks.criterion: Invoice management supports the core create/search/filter/print/delete flow
checks.name: invoice-create-search-filter-actions
checks.evidence: Seeded invoice visible; search and status filter operated; new draft saved and appeared with Zomatech Logistics Pvt Ltd and ₹12,345; export control visible.

checks.criterion: Client CRM and recurring billing support local changes
checks.name: clients-add-gstin
checks.evidence: Added tscheck-client with GSTIN 27TSCHK1234F1Z5 and both values appeared in the client list.

checks.criterion: Client CRM and recurring billing support local changes
checks.name: recurring-create-pause-resume
checks.evidence: Created a ₹7,777 recurring schedule, toggled it to Resume/Paused state, then toggled it back to Pause/Active.

checks.name: reports-settings-save-theme
checks.evidence: Reports trend rendered, period and export controls operated; settings business name/theme changed and save success appeared.

checks.criterion: Responsive shell and session flow are usable
checks.name: responsive-shell-signout
checks.evidence: At 390x844 mobile viewport, public menu opened, demo login reached app, dashboard menu opened, and Sign out returned to /.
